items.title: Bitcoin on exchanges: 13.3% of supply, down from 16.8% in Aug 2021 (Apr 2026 low was the lowest since May 2018)
items.description: Share of all bitcoin held on exchange wallets, monthly since January 2018: 13.3% of supply in October 2026, down from a 16.8% peak in August 2021, with the April 2026 low the lowest since May 2018.
items.reason: On-chain trackers (Lookonchain, EmberCN) flagged Abraxas Capital pulling about 17,597 BTC (~$1.04B, average ~$59,206) off Binance and Kraken during the dip below $60,000, the latest drain on exchange balances.

items.title: Strategy denominated in BTC (MSTR/BTC)
items.description: Strategy's share price measured in bitcoin (MSTR/BTC) since August 2020: about 0.0016 BTC per share in mid-November 2026, roughly a third of the 0.005 peak in November 2024.
items.reason: Saylor posted his "dots aren't done" buy chart this morning, hinting at another purchase on Monday while Strategy's coins sit below their reported ~$75K average cost; this shows how the stock has fared against the bitcoin it holds.

items.title: Borrowing for AI: total debt at each fiscal year end vs the latest quarter
items.description: Total debt at Oracle, Amazon, Meta, Alphabet, Microsoft and CoreWeave at each fiscal year end since 2021 vs June 2026: Alphabet went from $12bn (FY2024) to $101bn, Amazon from $58bn to $133bn and Meta from $29bn to $84bn, while Microsoft fell to $40bn.
items.reason: Musk warned that the AI build-out could hit a working-capital crunch next year because hardware is paid for up front while revenue lags, and server makers are now repricing signed AI-server contracts. This chart shows how much of the build-out is already being borrowed.

items.title: Tesla R&D spending as a share of revenue, trailing four quarters
items.description: Tesla research and development spending as a share of revenue, trailing four quarters, 2017 to Q3 2026: 8.56% in Q3 2026, up from a 3.46% low in 2023 and the highest since mid-2018.
items.reason: Musk said on Sunday that Tesla's next AI5 chip (roughly 12x the compute of AI4) is going to Optimus while cars stay on AI4. The chip and robot push is showing up in Tesla's rising R&D intensity.

items.title: The cost of missing the best days: $10,000 in the S&P 500, Oct 2006 – Oct 2026 (price only)
items.description: What $10,000 in the S&P 500 became from October 2006 to October 2026 (price only): $58,008 fully invested, $25,828 after missing the 10 best days, and $9,973 after missing the 30 best days.
items.reason: After the S&P 500's worst week since April 2025 pushed it into a correction, with PCE and GDP data due in a short Thanksgiving week, this shows what sitting out just a handful of the best days has cost a long-term holder.
